Product Designer focused on user-centered interfaces and end-to-end product flows. Notice period: 30 days.

Product Designer, PhonePe — Oct 2024 - Present
Led design work for a consumer payments feature aimed at increasing successful bill payments. Conducted rapid Figma iterations for the flow, produced high-fidelity screens in Figma and Adobe XD, and validated interactions with clickable prototypes. Collaborated with engineering via Jira in Agile sprints, reducing user error rate on the flow by a measurable amount through A/B-tested UI/UX adjustments. Ensured designs were Linux-friendly for internal test environments.

Product Designer, Ola — Mar 2021 - Sep 2024
Owned rider and driver app experiences for onboarding and payments. Delivered end-to-end UI/UX solutions using Adobe XD and Figma, building interactive Prototyping artifacts to align stakeholders and engineers. Partnered with product and engineering in Agile ceremonies, tracked implementation tasks in Jira, and refined screens for low-bandwidth Linux test environments. Iterations improved onboarding completion and reduced support tickets.

Skills: Figma, UI/UX, Prototyping, Adobe XD, Jira, Linux, Agile

Education: CA, ICAI
